items.title: Mahalaxmi Racecourse makeover: Architects moot urban wetland park
items.one_liner: Architects proposed transforming the Mahalaxmi Racecourse in Mumbai into an urban wetland park.
items.why: Demonstrates green-blue infrastructure interventions and stormwater retention concepts in the Global South.
items.action: Analyze the proposed wetland park design for insights on urban stormwater management.

items.title: Researchers call to understand who benefits from green space
items.one_liner: Researchers highlighted the need to better understand equity and who actually benefits from new urban green spaces.
items.why: Connects to environmental justice, plural values, and service delivery versus modeled supply potential.
items.action: Incorporate equity and distributional justice checks into urban greening analysis models.

items.title: Green space and health: more than a single exposure
items.one_liner: Nature published research examining green space exposure and human health benefits beyond single exposures.
items.why: Directly relates to assessing access to urban nature and human health benefits in urban ecosystem services.
items.action: Read the study to refine metrics for evaluating human benefits from urban nature access.

items.title: Rome Study Reveals Monitoring Station Selection Alters Estimates
items.one_liner: A Rome study showed that monitoring station selection significantly alters winter particulate pollution estimates.
items.why: Highlights data uncertainty, spatial statistics challenges, and monitoring bias in environmental planning.
items.action: Note the implications for spatial data reliability and uncertainty assessment in air quality.

items.title: Busan pushes for Nakdong River estuary national urban park
items.one_liner: Busan is pushing to designate the Nakdong River estuary as South Korea's first national urban park.
items.why: Illustrates large-scale urban river and wetland conservation planning in a major Asian urban context.
items.action: Track policy and spatial planning methods used for the estuary park designation.

items.title: Stakeholders Launch Sub-Catchment Management Plan for Wetland
items.one_liner: Stakeholders launched a sub-catchment management plan for the Nong Loup Ian Wetland with GGGI support.
items.why: Provides a practical reference for sub-catchment scale environmental planning and water yield management.
items.action: Examine the management plan for transferable spatial modeling and stakeholder approaches.

items.title: New FEBA brief calls for recognition of ecosystem loss
items.one_liner: A new FEBA brief calls for stronger recognition of ecosystem-related loss and damage in climate frameworks.
items.why: Informs international policy discourse on valuing ecosystem services and ecological degradation.
items.source: International Union for Conservation of Nature
items.action: Review the FEBA brief to integrate ecosystem loss metrics into environmental planning.

items.title: How Germany’s Banking Capital Cools Down Without Plugging In
items.one_liner: Forbes explored how Frankfurt utilizes urban design strategies for urban cooling and heat mitigation.
items.why: Offers practical insights into urban cooling and heat mitigation strategies in a temperate European setting.
items.action: Compare Frankfurt's passive cooling design strategies with semi-arid urban challenges.

items.title: Abu Dhabi advances family-centred urban planning initiatives
items.one_liner: The Urban Planning and Permits Centre advanced family-centred urban planning through 15 new initiatives.
items.why: Offers insight into municipal planning frameworks and development guidelines in arid regional contexts.
items.action: Review the initiative scope for approaches to human-centric urban design indicators.

items.title: Águeda’s young learners dive into river conservation
items.one_liner: Around 500 primary school pupils joined Águeda’s river education programme connecting education with local conservation.
items.why: Informs community-based approaches to local conservation and urban water resources in a European Green Leaf city.
items.action: Review how local river education links with urban ecosystem service frameworks.

items.title: How science is shaping Guimarães’ green transition
items.one_liner: Laboratório da Paisagem supports Guimarães’ green transition through climate research, urban planning, and education.
items.why: Provides a practical example of research-informed urban planning and green infrastructure application in Europe.
items.action: Examine the lab's methods for bridging climate research and municipal green planning.

note: Selected updates, not comprehensive coverage. Status is unverified unless supported by the quoted official excerpt.
